an5.294-302:1.1: [sāvatthinidānāni] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato nigaṇṭho …pe… muṇḍasāvako. …pe… jaṭilako …pe… paribbājako …pe… māgandiko …pe… tedaṇḍiko …pe… āruddhako …pe… gotamako …pe… devadhammiko yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an5.294-302:1.3: pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, abrahmacārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
an5.294-302:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato devadhammiko yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye’ti.
